root_cause: Checkout only supported Stripe and needed two Stripe secrets in Netlify, which were never supplied, so /afsluiten returned 503 for weeks. Arthur decided on 27 oct 2026 that Mollie is the payment route with the key in Supabase Vault.
prevention: Mollie recurring billing (first payment + 1 month / 12 months subscription) runs as Supabase Edge Functions reading MOLLIE_API_KEY from Vault via bg_geheim; webhook re-reads the payment from Mollie, provisioning is idempotent, yearly equals ten monthly fees; tests guard key handling, idempotency and amounts.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until a Mollie test payment completes end to end and the Netlify wiring (next PR) is merged

limitations: Edge Functions are not yet called from Netlify; wiring is the next PR
Cancellation and plan change self-service are not built
